purpose: Evaluation-only references for diagnostic_eval.py. Never read by task_criteria.py or saved_investigations.py, and never an inference input. Outcomes restate existing human references (cross-checked by tests); mechanism categories are coarse labels read from the quoted reference text.

categories.placement_outside_target: A required object rests or ends outside the target (drop, misplacement, never placed, displaced).
categories.incorrect_orientation: A required object is in/at the target but not in the required pose (e.g. flat instead of upright in a slot).

episodes.quote: End: green plates and cups/whisk contained in rack; no task objects left out on the table.
End state shows green plates lying flat / leaning incorrectly in the rack (not upright in plate slots).
Looks successfully stored despite dataset band suggesting wrong-way.
episodes.dispute: Local visual reference (medium-high confidence) conflicts with the dataset wrong-way band; the coverage audit could not adjudicate slot orientation from the single view. Excluded from outcome and mechanism scoring.

episodes.quote: The green plate is misplaced, and the task is not completed successfully. / Plate visibly moves/lifts then rests outside at ~45s; plates remain outside at the true end.
End: two green plates upright in rack with cups/whisk, but one green plate remains flat on the table. Incomplete placement.
No independent binary outcome annotation in retained package.
